_note: Synthetic evidence dataset owned by Developer 2 (data/evidence/**). Used by app.ai.retrieval and by the eval set. IDs follow the project convention POL-*, DEC-*, INC-*, evt_*. Synthetic - not real company data.

steps.name: Purchase Request
steps.description: An employee raises a purchase request for goods or services and submits it for processing.

steps.name: Extract Request Information
steps.description: Read the submitted request and extract supplier, items, amount, department and requester into structured fields.

steps.name: Identify Supplier
steps.description: Determine which supplier or catalogue item the request refers to, including substitutions when the requested item is unavailable.

steps.name: Verify Price
steps.description: Compare the requested unit price against the catalogue price and the supplier's historical price range for the item.

steps.name: Check Company Policy
steps.description: Check the request against the company procurement policies that apply to its department and amount.

steps.name: Search Historical Decisions
steps.description: Look for earlier decisions, exceptions and incidents that are relevant to the current request before deciding.

steps.name: Manager Approval
steps.description: The department manager reviews the request and approves or rejects the spend. This step carries financial commitment authority.

steps.name: Create Purchase Order
steps.description: Raise the purchase order with the approved supplier once manager approval is recorded.

policies.title: Procurement Approval Threshold
policies.rule: Any purchase request with a total amount above 2000 AZN must be approved by the department manager before a purchase order can be raised.

policies.title: Price Variance Tolerance
policies.rule: A requested unit price may not deviate from the catalogue price by more than 10 percent without documented approval. Deviations above 10 percent must be reviewed before the request proceeds.

policies.title: Preferred Supplier Requirement
policies.rule: Goods must be sourced from an approved preferred supplier unless that supplier cannot supply the item within the required date.

policies.title: Split Purchase Prohibition
policies.rule: A single requirement must not be split into multiple smaller purchase requests in order to remain below the approval threshold.

policies.title: Invoice Payment Terms
policies.rule: Invoices must be settled within 30 days of receipt. Suppliers offering payment terms longer than 45 days require a separate commercial approval.

policies.title: Direct Purchase Allowance Below Threshold
policies.rule: Purchase requests with a total amount up to 2000 AZN do not require manager approval and may be converted directly into a purchase order after the policy check passes.

decisions.title: Catalog Price Deviation Emergency Exception
decisions.reason: A supplier withdrawal left a single source for calibration equipment. Operations asked to proceed at a 22 percent deviation from catalogue price.

decisions.title: Substitution Policy for Unavailable Catalogue Items
decisions.reason: Clarified that a specialist may propose an equivalent substitute when the requested catalogue item is unavailable, provided the price check is repeated for the substitute.

decisions.title: Repeated Price Deviations Review
decisions.reason: Three consecutive requests from the same department exceeded the 10 percent price variance tolerance. The department argued that the catalogue prices were stale.

decisions.title: Approval Threshold for Small Purchases
decisions.reason: Procurement proposed removing manager approval for requests below 2000 AZN to shorten cycle time. Finance raised that the control also catches split purchases.

decisions.title: Emergency Purchases Bypass Price Check
decisions.reason: A proposal to let urgent operational purchases skip the price variance check entirely, arguing that delay costs more than the variance.

incidents.title: Unchecked Price Variance Accepted
incidents.impact: A purchase order for laboratory consumables was raised at a 31 percent premium over catalogue price because the price check step was skipped during a busy period. The variance was detected in the monthly reconciliation, after the goods were delivered.

incidents.title: Split Purchase Detected After Approval
incidents.impact: A capital requirement was split into three requests that individually stayed below the approval threshold but together exceeded it by a factor of three. Control only caught it in audit.

incidents.title: Preferred Supplier Bypassed Without Record
incidents.impact: Two orders went to a non-preferred supplier with no recorded justification, so the substitution decision could not be reconstructed later.
